levels.description: Less than 0.1% of annual revenue or budget
More than 15%, or threatens the viability of the organisation
Informal regulator feedback, minor findings, individual complaints resolved
Formal investigation or enforcement warning, claims by individuals
Formal enforcement action, significant fines, restrictions on activities, an order to stop or withdraw a system, a claim by a group of affected persons
Withdrawal of authorisation, criminal prosecution, penalties in the highest tier of Article 99, or the same breach established against every person the system has decided about
Limited trade or local press, quickly contained
National press coverage, sustained for days
International press, sustained coverage, loss of key customer or partner relationships
Total loss of public confidence, departure of the board or chief executive, sustained international coverage
Material and reversible detriment to some individuals
Serious or irreversible harm to some individuals, or material harm to many
Death, mass harm, or loss of fundamental rights at scale
Significant disruption, noticeable degradation of service
Major service disruption, large-scale customer impact, material complaints
Total service failure, mass customer harm, systemic operational breakdown
Controls exist, with known weaknesses or untested elements

levels.basis: Measurements on the organisation's own system and data, or an extensive public record
Limited measurement plus structured expert judgement, such as partial test results or checked vendor documentation
Mainly expert judgement or the supplier's own claims, such as workshops or vendor benchmarks not reproduced on your data
Speculative, with no relevant data or precedent, as with agentic and novel uses
